description: Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence pages. A bounded GET of https://gpai.ai is a 301 off-host redirect to https://oecd.ai, so entries is empty and oecd.ai is omitted. Rows store title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Reports and PDFs are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons is only CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA. CC BY-NC and CC BY-NC-SA, including IGO variants, are their own tokens. A mixed notice stays unknown. The Public Domain Mark is not CC0. uk_ogl needs the phrase open government licence. eu_reuse_decision needs Decision 2011/833/EU. All rights reserved, a copyright notice, a terms link, or a host name is not a licence. runner_wired is false. Not a belief collector.
